title: Learning allowance
clause: Employees may claim up to 400 USD per calendar year for approved learning. A signed office supplement replaces this amount for its covered employees.

title: Learning allowance
clause: Employees may claim up to 500 USD per calendar year for approved learning. A signed office supplement replaces this amount for its covered employees.

title: Proposed learning allowance
clause: Proposed allowance of 900 USD per calendar year.

title: West office learning allowance
clause: The West office replaces the company learning allowance with 650 USD per calendar year.

title: East office learning allowance
clause: The East office replaces the company learning allowance with 550 USD per calendar year.

title: South office learning allowance
clause: The South office replaces the company learning allowance with 650 USD per calendar year.

title: Standard headset replacement
clause: Standard headsets can be replaced every 24 months. A signed field-team exception, where applicable, takes precedence.

title: Earlier headset replacement
clause: Standard headsets can be replaced every 36 months.

title: Proposed headset replacement
clause: The proposed replacement interval is 12 months.

title: West field-team exception
clause: For West field staff, a standard headset may be replaced every 18 months. Other roles follow the company interval.

title: Travel claim filing window
clause: Submit the claim within 45 calendar days of the trip ending. An applicable signed office supplement replaces this window.

title: Travel claim filing window
clause: Submit the claim within 30 calendar days of the trip ending. An applicable signed office supplement replaces this window.

title: East office filing window
clause: East office employees have 20 calendar days after the trip ends to submit the claim.

title: Office transfer effective date
clause: For an office transfer, use the origin office before the signed effective date and the destination starting on that date. For learning, use the date of the course. An undated transfer notice does not establish an effective date. If the date is missing, give a definitive answer only if both offices give the same result; otherwise ask for the effective transfer date.
